CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Real third step toward a self-hosted PARENA compiler: selfhost/region.prn, a faithful PARENA-language port of src/region.c. Found and fixed 3 more real bugs including a genuine logic bug of its own (walk-let-bindings dropping outer scope bindings) caught by lifting the C reference's own real test cases verbatim. v0.87.0 (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e) (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
